title: Understanding Singular Values
text: When you apply PCA to a matrix, the singular values represent the amount of variance captured by each principal component. Think about what it means for a singular value to be zero in terms of variance.

title: Centering the Matrix
text: Remember that before applying PCA, the matrix is centered. This means subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values. How might this affect the singular values?

title: Matrix Structure
text: Consider the structure of the matrix with a column of ones. How does this column affect the variance captured by the principal components?
